notes.title: Mods day
notes.notes:
Today we created some examples of mods, to demonstrate how you can change the game so it fits you better.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906074369

How to add a new cover:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906199001

How to add a new action:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906347941

How to replace the action images (detailed shooting):
- see [url=http://porno-studio-tycoon.com/#mods]our website[/url] (and the link "put link to your mod here")

How to add a new script to the game:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906365596

How to add a new Quest to the game:
- see the folder (gameFolder) mods/quests (duplicate the "quests" folder, edit the contents, zip, upload)

How to replace inventory pictures:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906386527

How to replace actors images:
- see [url=http://porno-studio-tycoon.com/#mods]our website[/url] (and the link "put link to your mod here")

How to replace actors names:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=906412781

How to replace the action images (fast shooting):
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=844034175

How to add a new apartment?
- Mod "flat4" comes with the game (look into the "mods" folder). You can see the comments in the file code, there is also a file mods/flat4/img/for-mod-maker/bg-layout.jpg

[h1]How to use the Workshop mods?[/h1]
- Click "subscribe" on Mod page in the workshop
- Restart the game - Mod automatically downloads
- On the starting page, open the "Mods" menu and activate the mode

[h1]How to create your mod[/h1]
- Download the desired mod
- Duplicate the folder with the mod
- Create an archive of your folder
- At the starting page, open the "Mods" menu and activate the mod
- Make changes to your mod (do not forget about mod-about.txt and mod-image.jpg)
- Run the game and test your mod
- Make sure your mod works :)
- Close the game
- Create an archive of your folder (for example, you edited the folder my-first-mod - an archive my-first-mod.zip should be nearby)
- Make sure that my-first-mod.zip contains the folder my-first-mod
- Open the game in the "Disable Steam Overlay" mode
- At the starting page, open the "Mods" menu and upload your mod

[h1]How to install the mod not from a workshop[/h1]
- Download the archive to the mods folder
- Unzip
- At the starting page, open the "Mods" menu and activate the mod

[h1]We also want to remind you about already existing Mods![/h1]
Some of them are presented in the workshop (Good place for the SFW mods).
Some on the official website.
There is also a [url=http://porno-studio-tycoon.com/#mods]link to the page[/url] where you can publish your own Mod!

We would be happy to [url=https://twitter.com/TitThird]showcase best of your Mods in our Twitter[/url].

notes.title: New shooting system!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/47be4cc49275e6fe1ce7750e0c8b1894d728a4cc.jpg[/img]

(SFW and pornotron are kept, old saves work, old shooting system is availible via "Fast shooting" option at the start screen)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/8576ef99d326a874a80326cdaf00db1dbb383009.jpg[/img]

Become a director! Before, shooting took one minute - now it's a detailed creative process. You can choose roles for the actors for every action and apply modifiers. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/0472caa8cba99f6a4a0e4363e4707d639675d966.jpg[/img]

The system of scoring for the quality (as well as for the scenes and blocks) became transparent - you can see how many points are brought by every actor, director and crew member.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/f8ac1b77ce074eff4e8f6499378b31bd5c81c146.jpg[/img]

Actors now have only two mood indicators: power and wanna. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/b58bd8505a3938fadb3b0abb4ca398036b57e059.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/6e2b08895f03b0db9e02cc7c6ec6e0f0aeccfdb8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/c21823e48151d13d17fd2dd5da4536e81ea02611.jpg[/img]

The research tree now has 50 items. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/6c99f1d2357e2e61fb2767b40934efa183bfd302.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/23dfc36ff083b2427e3a03f55280b95e09436271.png[/img]

Reactions to coffee and other snacks are recorded to actor's profile, which, by the way, also contains actor's favorite actions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/23d8529cd91554333e4438ae6a50e6415e14cba4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Simplified mode
notes.notes:
Our game has pretty unique system. Do you have problems getting used to it or maybe you just want some easy game to relax? We are splitting the game into Hardcore (current version) and casual (upcoming easy mode). Dont worry, all previous saves will work, as well as all previous content.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/3fba1db2d336c9bc6a4462f429b65c19f266394b.png[/img]

If you tick the "Markets" checkbox the game will remain the same. 

If you uncheck "Markets": 

1. No more "hair", "body type", "temper", and other complicated stuff. Instead you will have likes and each country will become a market. No trends as well. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/f983cc6fa2058bed1c874db61469549ce31ffe1d.png[/img]

2. You can't research markets info anymore (Don't need it anyway)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/72e4b59b6de3d6ee380a0ee9eea845292184986c.png[/img]

3. Much more easy to hire actors.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/1c34450cdc03e562151886d6316a18d85235db99.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637836/fedd074dec088dc4a4bbd9e7557fe63b4d261972.png[/img]
